title: Understanding Poverty in China
description: This educational video explores the current state of poverty in China, focusing on statistics and real-life examples.

scenes.script: Poverty in China has seen significant changes over the years, affecting millions of lives.
scenes.prompt: Aerial view of a rural Chinese village, showcasing traditional houses and farming landscapes, with people working in fields, demonstrating life in poverty-stricken areas of China.

scenes.script: The share of the population in extreme poverty has decreased significantly in China over the years.
Despite progress, poverty still exists, affecting access to education and healthcare.
scenes.prompt: Footage of children in a rural classroom in China, showing them studying, with limited resources, and a teacher engaging with students, highlighting the challenges faced in education due to poverty.

scenes.script: The poverty gap index indicates ongoing challenges for those still living in poverty in China.
